text: Because each matrix element of an MZI mesh depends on many phase shifters, independent per-device phase errors of size sigma compound to a relative output error that grows roughly as sqrt(N(N-1)/2)*sigma.
explanation: True: mesh error is 'entangled' because every output depends on every shifter, so independent errors add in quadrature to about sqrt(N(N-1)/2)*sigma. This is why uncorrected meshes achieve only ~4-5 bits of matrix fidelity while self-configured ones reach 6-8 bits.
